correctness.rationale: Twist compatibility is solved exactly by the eigenspace decomposition of phi, leaving a five-parameter block matrix. Direct bracket substitution yields exactly two scalar equations. The a=0 and a!=0 cases are exhaustive over characteristic not two; the latter excludes a=2 and forces p=0 and t=a/(2-a). A concrete printed-family false positive has twist defect -2e2. Exhaustive checks over F3, F5, F7, and F11 reproduce the classification and rank formulas.
